understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, progressing until the game is won while avoiding spikes and using no more than two attempts per level.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is horizontal via MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT, followed by automatic falling in the current gravity direction until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Landing on u or v spikes ends the attempt. CLICK targets a coordinate and can remove breakable x blocks to open paths; clicks do not advance the rising-platform timer. UNDO reverts the previous action. The landing previews and corridor scan indicate where each horizontal move will end and which columns lead to new sections.
